title: Components and props
summary: Turn repeated markup into components and pass each one the data it should show through props. You will set default values, see why props are read-only, wrap content with children, and map a small page into a component tree.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
